def lookup : Assignment → Nat → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | (v', x) :: rest, v => if v' = v then x else lookup rest v

def values (a : Assignment) (vars : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  vars.map (lookup a)

def sumList (xs : List Nat) : Nat :=
  xs.foldl (· + ·) 0

def allDistinct : List Nat → Bool
  | [] => true
  | x :: xs => (! xs.contains x) && allDistinct xs

def allInSet (xs s : List Nat) : Bool :=
  xs.all (fun x => s.contains x)

fun c a =>
    match c with
    | .allDifferent vars => allDistinct (values a vars)
    | .exactSum vars k => sumList (values a vars) == k
    | .maxSum vars k => sumList (values a vars) ≤ k
    | .minSum vars k => k ≤ sumList (values a vars)
    | .inSet vars s => allInSet (values a vars) s

def enumerate : List (List Nat) → Nat → List Assignment
  | [], _ => [[]]
  | dom :: rest, idx =>
    let tails := enumerate rest (idx + 1)
    dom.flatMap (fun v => tails.map (fun t => (idx, v) :: t))

fun domains constraints =>
    match domains with
    | [] => []
    | _ => (enumerate domains 0).filter (fun a => constraints.all (fun c => holds c a))

theorem pyc_lookup_eq_refLookup (a : Pythonconstraint.Assignment) (v : Nat) :
    Pythonconstraint.lookup a v = Pythonconstraint.refLookup a v := by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p rest ih =>
      cases p with
      | mk v' x => simp [Pythonconstraint.lookup, Pythonconstraint.refLookup, ih]

theorem pyc_values_eq_refValues (a : Pythonconstraint.Assignment) (vars : List Nat) :
    Pythonconstraint.values a vars = Pythonconstraint.refValues a vars := by
  simp [Pythonconstraint.values, Pythonconstraint.refValues, pyc_lookup_eq_refLookup]

theorem pyc_sumList_eq_refSumList (xs : List Nat) :
    Pythonconstraint.sumList xs = Pythonconstraint.refSumList xs := by
  rfl

theorem pyc_allDistinct_eq_refAllDistinct (xs : List Nat) :
    Pythonconstraint.allDistinct xs = Pythonconstraint.refAllDistinct xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp [Pythonconstraint.allDistinct, Pythonconstraint.refAllDistinct, ih]

theorem pyc_allInSet_eq_refAllInSet (xs s : List Nat) :
    Pythonconstraint.allInSet xs s = Pythonconstraint.refAllInSet xs s := by
  rfl

intro c a
  cases c <;>
    simp [canonical, Pythonconstraint.holds, Pythonconstraint.holdsRef,
      pyc_values_eq_refValues, pyc_sumList_eq_refSumList,
      pyc_allDistinct_eq_refAllDistinct, pyc_allInSet_eq_refAllInSet]
